visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair and glasses, wearing a black hoodie with a small white logo and grey/black cargo pants, stands in a large indoor garage. He gestures towards cars parked in the background, including a black sedan and a white SUV. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) He approaches a white Ford Mustang and opens the hood. The camera zooms in on a large 5.0L engine with silver intake manifolds. The setting is clean and well-lit. (3) He points to a clear plastic cover over an air filter modification. His hands move specifically around the technical components of the engine bay. (4) He uses his smartphone's flashlight to inspect the lower parts of the engine block, leaning deep into the engine bay to look for fluid leaks. (5) He points to the underside of the car's hood, showing a section where the paint is different, explaining structural indicators. (6) He moves to the front of the car, pointing at the grille and logo, then gestures to the internal frame members visible behind the bumper. (7) A close-up of the rear of the car reveals a circular emblem with a cobra snake and the text 'Shelby GT500'. (8) He opens the trunk to show a large silver air tank and dual compressors for an air suspension system, which are integrated into the trunk floor. (9) He sits in the driver's seat, showing the digital instrument cluster displaying '66555.7 km'. (10) The scene shifts to the man driving the car on a highway during daylight. He gestures with his hands while talking to the camera from the driver's perspective. (11) He reaches down to press a button on a small red electronic module mounted near the center console. (12) He revs the engine while driving, with a visible smile and energetic facial expressions as the car accelerates. (13) He continues driving and talking, concluding with a price-related gesture by raising his hand.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male voice speaking quickly over an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong 4/4 beat. A soft mechanical 'click' is heard as the car hood is unlatched. (2) Vocal intensity increases as the speaker highlights the engine; a transient 'thud' occurs as the hood fully opens. The BGM maintains a steady tempo. (3) A sharp 'snap' sound of plastic occurs as an engine cover is manipulated. The speaker's pitch rises during the explanation of the intake system. (4) Background ambient noise includes faint garage echoes. A distinct 'beep' SFX plays during a jump cut transition. (5) As the speaker transitions to driving, a sudden roar of a high-performance V8 engine (loud, broadband noise, high percussiveness) dominates the mix, momentarily masking the BGM. (6) Wind noise increases during the driving sequence, creating a higher frequency noise floor. The speaker's voice becomes slightly strained but remains clear and authoritative. (7) A loud mechanical 'click-clack' sequence is heard as the exhaust valve module is activated. (8) Repeated engine revving sounds (low-frequency growls and high-frequency mechanical whines) create a highly dynamic acoustic texture. (9) The audio concludes with a humorous laughter track SFX and a final energetic slogan delivered by the speaker over the fading BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a professional appraisal and promotional showcase for a used Ford Mustang Shelby GT500. It demonstrates the technical inspection process to build trust regarding vehicle quality and culminates in a high-energy performance demonstration to appeal to car enthusiasts' emotions.
